paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入160mLDMF、11.8g  2-四氢呋喃甲醇(99％，0.115mol)和17.3g氢氧化钠溶液(30％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为94.6％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率88.4％。
paragraphs.en: 160mL DMF, 11.8g 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol (99％, 0.115mol) and 17.3g sodium hydroxide solution (30％, 0.13mol) were charged into the reactor, stirring was started, the kettle temperature was controlled at 5℃, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98.2％, 0.1mol) prepared in step (1) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 2h; after the addition was finished the reaction was held at temperature for 4h. When the reaction was complete, solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. Then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.6g of product; HPLC quantification gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 94.6％, and a two-step reaction yield of 88.4％ calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: This paragraph completes Example 15, whose scheme is the drawing at marker [0165] at the top of this page. 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol is translated literally as 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol; it is tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, the reagent abbreviated THFA over the arrow. The percentages given for the alcohol and the sodium salt are purities, while 30％ is the concentration of the caustic solution.

paragraphs.en: 50mL of 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol was charged into the reactor, stirring was started, and 5.2g of sodium hydride (60％, 0.13mol) was added at room temperature; stirring was continued until dissolution was complete, and after solvent removal under reduced pressure with a high-vacuum oil pump, solid sodium 2-tetrahydrofuranmethoxide was obtained, sealed

drawings.notes: Scheme for Example 15, whose text is at [0166]. Above the arrow the two reagents are separated by the Chinese enumeration comma, printed as THFA followed by an enumeration comma then NaOH. The tetrahydrofuran ring in the product is drawn with plain bonds and no wedge or hash, so the drawing does not assign configuration at the ring C2; the prose calls the product (RS), i.e. racemic, which is consistent with the undrawn stereocentre. The ring numbering above is read off the drawing: the carboxylate-bearing carbon is taken as C1, and Cl sits between the carboxylate and the bromomethyl group, with the methylsulfonyl group adjacent to the bromomethyl group on the other side.

drawings.notes: Scheme for Example 17, whose text begins at [0176] and continues onto the next page. Unlike the two schemes above it, this one carries no written reagent name over the arrow: the reagent above the arrow is drawn as a structure, a tetrahydrofuran ring bearing a CH2ONa group at the ring carbon adjacent to the ring oxygen, with only the letters ONa lettered in. No base is shown over the arrow, because the alkoxide is itself the base and nucleophile. Neither the reagent alkoxide nor the product carries a stereo bond at the tetrahydrofuran C2.

discrepancies.what: The DMF solvent used in Examples 15 and 16 appears only in the prose, never in the schemes.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The arrows at [0165] and [0170] carry only THFA and the hydroxide base above, and HCl below. No solvent.
discrepancies.text_says: [0166] charges 160mL DMF and [0171] charges 70mL DMF as the reaction solvent.

discrepancies.what: The reagent abbreviation THFA over the arrows is never expanded anywhere on this page.
discrepancies.drawing_says: THFA above the arrows at [0165] and [0170].
discrepancies.text_says: [0166] and [0171] name the reagent as 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol, i.e. tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, which matches THFA, but the page never states the abbreviation.

discrepancies.what: In Example 17 the sodium hydride that generates the alkoxide is written but not drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The [0175] arrow shows the preformed alkoxide, sodium (tetrahydrofuran-2-yl)methoxide, as the only reagent above it.
discrepancies.text_says: [0176] makes the alkoxide in situ from 50mL 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol and 5.2g sodium hydride (60％, 0.13mol), then strips solvent to isolate it as a solid; the hydride step is absent from the scheme.

discrepancies.what: The schemes draw a single achiral product while the prose names it as a racemate.
discrepancies.drawing_says: All three product structures show plain bonds at the tetrahydrofuran C2, so no configuration is assigned.
discrepancies.text_says: [0166], [0169], [0171] and [0174] all name the product 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, with an explicit (RS) descriptor.

discrepancies.what: The yields in Examples 15 and 16 are stated against a methyl ester that is not the starting material drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The schemes at [0165] and [0170] start from the sodium carboxylate salt.
discrepancies.text_says: [0166] and [0171] both report the two-step yield calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, the methyl ester, which is the starting material of step (1) on an earlier page.
